description: The PR renames loadUser to findUser, updates its caller and moves it to the end of the file; main edits a line of its body. The right result is findUser at the end with main’s edit. Gnosis proposes it in Check, with a note that call sites in other files were not checked. Mergiraf fails on this case, so it tests the move rule alone (#445 item 17); with Mergiraf, its own whole-file proposal comes first.
